name: Maren Oduya
bio: Maren keeps the servers boring. She writes about rendering, storage, and the unglamorous work of making a site stay up.

name: Tobias Rask
bio: Tobias has shipped more navigation rewrites than he cares to admit. These days he is interested in how pages feel, not just how fast they load.

name: Priya Venkatesan
bio: Priya works on the tools between an idea and a deploy. She writes about forms, authoring, and the small details that make a codebase pleasant.
